reason: Reviewed non-promoting characterization/design; excluded from the 461 assertion-bearing case credit; source retained.

contract.intent: A notification that already entered must complete after its retained registration is released
preconditions: Local callback barrier; notification completion ledger
trace: Retain observer and require notify returns queued without awaiting callback
Observe callback entry before removing slot and original
Require successful notification completion, no error and single disposal
contract.failure_schedule: Explicit named gate is released only after observed entry; no time-based race; at most one injected failure when the trace names it
contract.stress: Fire-and-forget callback lifetime across final registration release
contract.oracle: Entry continues once while future dispatch is removed; no swallowed failure
contract.cleanup: Release all local and provider barriers, remove retained and borrowed handles, await tracked calls, dispose every owned handle in reverse order, verify local callback cohort counts and provider created/disposed equality, then delete per-case state. Supervisor tears down owned fleet after timeout or unknown cleanup.
contract.distinctness: Literal O027 state transition; counts, repetitions and deployment placements do not create additional cases.
